metadataRaw.title: How to Relieve Bone on Bone Hip Pain in 30 SECONDS
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve arthritic bone on bone hip pain.

These exercises are especially good for hip impingement and wear-and tear arthritis. They will focus on pulling motions, known as traction, to help reduce pressure in the hips. 

Think of a deep stretch that can open up the hips, instantly relieving stiffness and pain... even within 30 seconds.

Please let us know how the exercises work for you! 

Link to resistance band: https://amzn.to/3AwRZdd
Link to ankle weight: https://amzn.to/3pWqjtw

0:00 Intro
1:01 Bed Traction Method
2:09 Stick Opener (for Hip Rotation)
4:01 Ankle Weight Method
6:35 Banded Traction #1
